why: The reports beside this file are real @playwright/test 1.62.0 output, not hand-written shapes. The earlier harnesses invented a report shape the real runner never writes, and encoded an identity bug in the fixture that was supposed to catch it.

runner.source: copied from the private desktop app's installed node_modules into a scratch directory; no private source, spec or test name was used or recorded

synthetic_app.config: testDir ./tests/e2e, fullyParallel false, workers 1, retries 1 under CI, projects smoke (grep @smoke), critical (grep @critical, grepInvert @smoke), shell-browser (grep @browser-shell, grepInvert @smoke) - the tier shape of the real desktop config
specs: tests/e2e/flows.spec.ts: nested describes and parameterized titles
tests/e2e/deep/inner.spec.ts: a spec in a nested directory, which is what exposes the path normalisation
tests/e2e/outcomes.spec.ts (separate app): a flaky retry, an intentional skip and a plain pass

commands.execution_feedback: node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config playwright.config.ts --project smoke --project critical --project shell-browser --reporter=json
commands.execution_outcomes: CI=1 node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config playwright.config.ts --project smoke --reporter=json

observed.execution_file_paths: relative to testDir: flows.spec.ts and deep/inner.spec.ts

placeholders.__APP_ROOT__: the absolute app root the reports were produced under; each test substitutes its own temporary directory
placeholders.__SCRATCH__: the scratch directory above that app root
